verdict: Peanuts are the better pick. Calories are about the same, but protein is much higher so they're more filling.
why: Calories are about the same for 30 g: cassava chips an estimated 160 kcal, peanuts an estimated 170 kcal.
Peanuts have 7 g protein, cassava chips only 1 g.
Peanuts have more fat, 14 g vs 9 g, but they keep you full longer.
Both are easy to overeat if you eat straight from a big pack while watching TV.
when_a: Kerepek ubi (cassava chips) is okay when you take only 1 small pack, not the big bag from the sundry shop.
when_b: Peanuts are okay as an afternoon snack at the office. Just one handful, put in a small container.
tip: Pour into a small plate or container first. Don't eat straight from the bag, it's easy to lose count.

faq.q: Peanuts are high in fat, isn't that bad for a diet?
faq.a: The fat in peanuts can fit into a diet. What matters is the amount, one handful is about 30 g. More than that and calories go up quickly.

faq.q: Are boiled peanuts better than fried peanuts?
faq.a: Boiled peanuts are usually lower in calories for the same amount because no oil is used. If you have the choice, give them a try.
